title: Shared package and release preparation environment inputs
description: Reference declarations of existing behavior, not an automatically executed validator. These inputs belong to the named consumers; they are not required settings for every package. Programmatic options may override the release environment inputs.

LOG_LEVEL.description: Optional input to the logger module factory. The factory substitutes info only when the environment value is absent; it does not validate or replace an empty or unknown string. The hosting application is responsible for choosing a level supported by its logging runtime.

NODE_ENV.description: Host/framework input interpreted by the logger module factory. Exactly development adds the pretty-transport configuration. Every other value or absence omits that configuration; no enum validation is performed here.

RELEASE_PLAN_DIR.description: Release preparation job output directory, required by its CLI unless planDir is supplied programmatically. The job supplies a temporary directory. Preparation creates the directory recursively; no fixed host path or default is provided.

GITHUB_OUTPUT.description: Optional GitHub runner-provided output-file path for release preparation, overridden by a programmatic outputPath. When truthy, preparation appends its mode output to the existing file. Absence or an empty value skips that append. Local verification uses only owned synthetic paths.
